name: April & Marisa (and Arnold)
source:
April the meek and artsy. Marisa the hot-headed and passionate...

...And Arnold! ^w^

Two friends' recess break turns into something special thanks to a special monkey stuffed animal!

[From [url=https://astarsor.itch.io/april-marisa-and-arnold]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
四月是温顺而有艺术气息的。玛丽莎是个头脑发热又热情的人……

…还有阿诺德！^w^

多亏了特殊的猴子毛绒动物，两个朋友的课间休息变得很特别！

[来自[url=https://astarsor.itch.io/april-marisa-and-arnold]itch.io[/url]]
